intent: After turn/completed, reconcile plan-bound and interaction-bound proposals, and start at most one successor only when it is the sole safe plan-bound option.

required_conditions: plan-bound proposals originate in a digest-bound declared continuation plan
interaction-bound proposals preserve attributed chat or human meaning without trusting prose as authority
reconcile both lanes with mechanism-observed evidence
an interaction-bound proposal gates until a human decision binds its exact digest
multiple surviving proposals across either lane gate
zero options complete only when continuation is unnecessary
one safe reversible plan-bound option with no interaction-bound proposal may be direct
direct does not perform the successor
